create_gym_wrapper: create a GymInterfaceWrapper to wrap an AndroidEnv with an OpenAI Gym interface
convert_dm_env_spec_to_gym_space: convert a dm_env spec to an OpenAI Gym space using _spec_to_space
render_gym_environment: render the GymInterfaceWrapper environment as an rgb_array using the render method
reset_gym_environment: reset the GymInterfaceWrapper environment and return the initial observation
step_gym_environment: take a step in the GymInterfaceWrapper environment with an action dict
